10317 Fallen Leaf is exactly what Woodway living is supposed to feel like. 🌳

This custom-built 4 bed, 2 bath home is just under 1,900 sq ft, only about 5 years old, and you can tell the owners babied it. The curb appeal is crazy good, but the inside is even better – open layout, modern finishes, and a super clean, move-in ready feel.

Located in the tucked-away Creekside subdivision just off Highway 84, you’re close to shopping, dining, and everything Waco has to offer without feeling like you’re in the middle of the chaos. Quiet, established, and convenient – that combo is hard to beat.
